title: Material Gun
body:
A special tool that can vacuum up materials from resources or schematics, and can be used to selectively fill schematics to the required amount!

Introduction

The Material Gun is a specialized tool that assists with building. It can store materials up to its storage limit. The gun has three modes; consume, swap, and fill. This tool is not necessary to fill schematics but will benefit players by saving materials. The manual way of filling schematics (placing loose material into a schematic) has a risk of overfilling. The Material Gun is able to fill schematics precisely.(note: Once items are consumed they cannot be removed in item form )

The "consume" mode will store any material from loose items (i.e. logs, rocks, ore, fabric rolls, stained glass) or from filled schematics.

The "swap" mode will take the selected material from the gun's selection UI and replace any filled or unfilled schematic with said material.

The "fill" mode will fill any empty schematics. It will not work on filled schematics.

The base pricing of the Material Gun is $99,999. The upgrades start at $5000.

Upgrades

Material Gun Upgrades
Upgrade # Pricing Results
Upgrade 1 5000 +50µm
Upgrade 2 5000 +50µm

As you pay $5000, you gain +50µm space in your material gun.

Trivia

  • The Material Gun can be found at The Oak Depot.
  • It fills schematics with materials such as trees, rocks, ores, and dyed items.
  • The Material Gun has a gamepass available to maximize storage to infinity.
  • The Material Gun's tank will change texture and color to showcase the selected material.
  • The Material Gun resembles the Vacpack from the Slime Rancher franchise.
